items.title: Michel Hazanavicius To Present Exclusive Footage Of 'The Third Hand' In AI Case Study At Les Arcs
items.excerpt: Oscar winner Michel Hazanavicius and post house Digital District will show exclusive footage of The Third Hand at Les Arcs Film Festival in December, explaining the method and AI tools used to make the film.

items.title: Microdrama revenues hit $20bn in 2026, but profits remain elusive outside China
items.excerpt: A Media Partners Asia report puts global microdrama revenue up 24% to $20bn; about 75% of titles were made using AI, at roughly a tenth of an LA-shot series' cost, while AI accounts for nine in ten Chinese titles but only 20% of revenue.

items.title: David Fincher Explains AI Use in 'Cliff Booth' and How AI Can Be Used on Film Sets to Reduce the Amount of Takes
items.excerpt: Fincher admitted in an interview that some AI was used in post-production on The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, but said it was all done to enhance the work of real human beings, and described how AI could reduce the number of takes on set.

items.title: David Fincher Details His Vision for AI Filmmaking That Is Still 'Based on Real Human Beings'
items.excerpt: The Cliff Booth director outlined how he sees AI being used in the filmmaking process, following backlash over suspected AI in the Netflix film.

history_match.title: David Fincher Defends Use Of AI Amid 'Cliff Booth' Criticism: "Well, It Exists. Should We Not Use It?"

items.title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
items.excerpt: Early screenings of the Cliff Booth sequel drew accusations of 'blatant' generative-AI footage from viewers including director Patrick Tomasso; Netflix has neither confirmed nor denied AI use, while some critics suggest it is just bad CGI.

items.title: Unreal Engine 6 Will Ship Without Blueprints
items.excerpt: Epic is dropping Blueprints from UE6 and betting AI can automatically convert UE5 projects to Verse, citing a Fortnite prototype that ported 20,000+ visual scripts; UE 5.9 brings MCP improvements, wider Python access and Unreal Canvas asset generation first.

items.title: Introducing Brand Kit and Character Library
items.excerpt: Luma launched Brand Kit and Character Library so uploaded logos, fonts, products and characters stay consistent across every generated image and video, targeting the character drift that keeps AI out of serialized and branded work.

items.title: 일레븐랩스, 국내 AI 단편제작 프로젝트 '더 콜라보레이션 2026'에 기술 파트너로 참여

items.title: KOBIS 일별 박스오피스: AI 장편 '라파엘' 개봉 2일차(11/26) 관객 655명, 누적 2,050명
items.excerpt: 100% 생성형 AI 장편 '라파엘'(MBC C&I·마테오AI스튜디오)이 개봉 2일차인 11월 26일 51개 스크린 65회 상영에서 관객 655명(전일 대비 +21.5%)을 모아 일일 27위, 누적 관객 2,050명을 기록했다.

items.title: ByteDance opens Seedance 2.5's 4K video generation API to developers
items.excerpt: ByteDance's Volcano Engine opened API access to the 4K version of its Seedance 2.5 video model, which it pitches at film production, widening availability beyond its own apps.

items.title: Maxon Plus: New AI-Assisted Tools and 3D Review Services
items.excerpt: Maxon introduced Maxon Plus, a separate suite of connected services with a Model Generator (text or image to 3D base model), Texture Generator and browser-based 3D review, integrated with Cinema 4D and ZBrush. (Note: design section ran a Creative Bloq Maxon story 11-24; check cross-section dup.)

items.title: Netflix AI clause divides Germany's dubbing industry over voice training rights
items.excerpt: German voice actors including Katrin Froehlich (Cameron Diaz), Anne Helm (Margot Robbie) and Luise Helm (Scarlett Johansson) refuse to sign a Netflix contract clause letting it use their voices to train AI, so they will no longer dub those stars on Netflix.
